name: Ōyamada (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ōyamada village emblem in white: an outlined ring with three short spokes enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former village of Ōyamada in Mie Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-11-01.

features.role: Ōyamada village emblem — an outlined ring with three short spokes enclosing a stylised character
